info.name: Dubhu Designer
info.description: Postman collection for Dubhu Designer API, covering Tool and Instruction management endpoints. Instructions reference tools using the `{{tool:tool_id}}` syntax.

item.name: Tools
item.description: Endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, and updating tool specifications.

request.description: Creates a new tool specification with initial version 1. Automatically saves the created tool's ID to the collection variable `toolId` upon success.
Retrieves all tools registered in the system.

variable.description: Hexadecimal MongoDB ObjectID of the tool

request.description: Retrieves a specific tool specification by its hexadecimal MongoDB ObjectID.

variable.description: Hexadecimal MongoDB ObjectID of the tool

request.description: Updates an existing tool specification using optimistic concurrency control. Requires the current version number in the payload. Increments version on success.

item.name: Instructions
item.description: Endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, and updating instruction specifications. Content references tools via {{tool:tool_id}} chips.

request.description: Creates a new instruction. Referenced tools are extracted from {{tool:tool_id}} chips, checked for existence, and linked to the instruction. Saves the created instruction's ID to `instructionId` on success.
Retrieves summaries of all instructions in the system without embedding full tool specifications.

variable.description: Hexadecimal MongoDB ObjectID of the instruction

request.description: Retrieves an instruction by its ID, fully resolving and populating all referenced tools.

variable.description: Hexadecimal MongoDB ObjectID of the instruction

request.description: Updates an existing instruction using optimistic concurrency control. Validates referenced tool IDs and increments version on success.
